findings.claim: Cloudflare 向少數供應商採購網路與伺服器設備，10-K 風險因子列明關稅可能推高這些設備價格。
findings.excerpt: Our reliance on these suppliers exposes us to risks, including reduced control over production costs, increased prices due to tariffs (such as the tariffs the United States and other countries recently implemented or threatened to implement)

findings.claim: MD&A 說明部分網路設備來自美國境外供應商，或來自再向境外採購零件的美國供應商，公司與供應商評估關稅影響並調整採購來源。
findings.excerpt: We purchase a portion of the equipment that we use to operate our network from suppliers located outside the United States and we also purchase this equipment from United States suppliers that themselves purchase components from suppliers located outside the United States.

findings.claim: BIS 於 2025-09-29 發布擴大 Entity List 適用範圍的「Affiliates rule」；該規則已於 2025-11-10 暫停一年，10-K 稱若實施將大幅提高 EAR 合規門檻。
findings.excerpt: On September 29, 2025, the U.S. Department of Commerce’s Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) released an interim final rule that expanded export control restrictions and licensing requirements under the EAR Entity List and Military End-User List

findings.claim: 2019 年自揭的 OFAC 制裁合規案件，截至 10-K 仍在 OFAC 審查中。
findings.excerpt: The voluntary self-disclosure, which we may supplement as appropriate, remains under an ongoing review by OFAC.
